verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party HTTP API for sending event data from a source to connected destinations, plus a Pixel API for GET-based tracking, so server-to-server ingestion through a documented HTTP endpoint is its own capability. The evidence does not describe how requests are authenticated or what delivery guarantees apply (retries, durability, at-least-once semantics). missing for 10: documented authentication scheme for the HTTP API, documented delivery guarantees/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration of server-side ingestion.
